note: Travel playbooks for the Response Clock. Shared by the server (services/cases.py) and the browser demo (lib/clock.ts).

emergency.label: On-trip emergency
steps: Call the traveler now and confirm they are safe
Contact the operator, driver or hotel on site
Arrange help: pickup, clinic or another ride
Send the traveler an update every hour until solved

documents.label: Lost passport or documents
steps: Call the traveler and confirm where they are
Advise a police report at the nearest station
Coordinate with the embassy or DFA for a travel document
Rebook flights or hotel nights if needed

transfer.label: Flight or transfer problem
steps: Confirm the flight or pickup details
Contact the airline, driver or transfer provider
Give the traveler the new time or a replacement ride
Check if the rest of the itinerary is affected

hotel.label: Hotel problem
steps: Call the hotel's front desk
Ask for a room change or an immediate fix
Offer another hotel if not fixed today
Confirm with the traveler that it is solved

refund.label: Refund or payment
steps: Check the payment record (GCash, card or bank)
Confirm the amount and refund policy with the traveler
Send the refund request to accounting
Send the traveler the reference number

visa.label: Visa or travel documents
steps: Check the application status
Tell the traveler the status and the next date
Ask for any missing requirements
Confirm once the visa is released

booking.label: Booking or confirmation
steps: Find the booking in the system
Fix or resend the confirmation and e-ticket
Confirm the details with the traveler

tour.label: Tour experience
steps: Reply and acknowledge the concern
Ask the guide or coordinator what happened
Offer a fix or a goodwill gesture
Confirm the traveler is satisfied

general.label: Customer concern
steps: Reply and acknowledge the concern
Find out what happened from the team
Offer a solution
Confirm the customer is satisfied

sample_cases.text: Naiwan po kami ng bangka sa island hopping sa Coron, stranded kami dito. Pakitulungan po.
Nawala po passport ko dito sa Seoul, ano po gagawin ko? Flight na namin sa Biyernes.
Naaksidente yung van namin papuntang hotel sa Bohol. May sugat po yung kasama namin.
Nag-food poisoning kami after ng kasamang lunch sa El Nido tour. Tatlo na kaming nagsusuka.
Sira ang aircon ng hotel room namin sa Boracay at walang sumasagot sa front desk. Hindi kami makatulog.
Charged twice po ako sa GCash para sa Boracay package, paki-check naman po. Wala pa rin pong sagot.
Follow up lang po sa refund ng cancelled Japan tour ko, wala pa rin hanggang ngayon.
Pa-follow up po, wala pa rin yung booking confirmation email ko. Flight na namin bukas.
